Blade

You make the hard choices in the space between one stroke and the next.

Rules

Agreed: minimum 0 in Agility, Brawn; HP contribution +4. No multiclassing.

Starting disciplines: choose two distinct rank-1 disciplines from Arms, Marksmanship, Athletics, Subterfuge.

Discipline pricing: Home: Arms, Marksmanship. Adjacent: Athletics, Subterfuge. All others Foreign; no Opposed disciplines.

Choose one class-exclusive signature at levels 1, 3 and 7. Extra signatures cost 2/4/8 DP. No discipline requirements.

Level 1 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b81024b8b9cf1fe1.JournalEntryPage.058c5dc014b67c3d]{Cut and Turn} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.27674ae32fd6acd4.JournalEntryPage.d982fe095c98ceda]{Pressure Point} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b17ce9b211193c7f.JournalEntryPage.6b4bca7533b85309]{Measured Guard}

Level 3 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.c1224f63533d49c6.JournalEntryPage.598b944885d66dc1]{Sweeping Entry} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.1cc9e3bafcf7a84e.JournalEntryPage.062d4ae9a28c847c]{Return Stroke} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.6dcdc4b2400a5e14.JournalEntryPage.b9e14fcf2dce6504]{Fell the Balance}

Level 7 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.9d3f63935dd7065c.JournalEntryPage.fc0b6b64271eb15a]{Dance Through Steel} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.e04cc138089557e7.JournalEntryPage.e00eb8e6b6140d3e]{Relentless Pursuit} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.1d33a734a8e1418e.JournalEntryPage.bb068adaf288a810]{Perfect Placement}

Signature identity in play

The revised options aim for these moments, with a deliberate advantage over shared cards of their tier. Each is an independent choice, not a progression chain.

- Level 1: Flow through melee, hinder a target, or guard and reposition. - Level 3: Enter decisively, counterattack, or take an opponent's footing. - Level 7: Strike a surrounding group, pursue and strike, or dictate where the duel moves.

Starting coin contribution: +4 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
